Read `.specs/roadmap.md` and parse tier sections (MVP, Post-MVP, Future, Deferred)

Compute next action per feature using status/plan/impl matrix
Flag Draft features with no plan older than 7 days
Flag features ready to implement (plan exists, no implementation)
Detect deferred items and missing plans
Render summary header with correct roadmap and feature counts
Render roadmap section (skipped if `--features`)
Render features table (skipped if `--roadmap`)
Render status gaps section if actionable gaps detected
Emit JSON payload instead of formatted output (if `--json`)
